关键词: 2015 Q4 Results Conference Call and Webcast for Investors and Analysts
主要内容: This document is a Form 6-K filing by Brookfield Asset Management Inc. dated January 19, 2016, which includes the 2015 Q4 Results Conference Call and Webcast for Investors and Analysts. The filing is submitted to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and includes an exhibit index. The company is based in Toronto, Canada, and its principal executive offices are located at Suite 300, Brookfield Place, 181 Bay Street, P.O. Box 762, Toronto, Canada M5J 2T3. The filing indicates that the company is submitting the form under Regulation S-T Rule 101(b)(7). The document is part of the company's reporting obligations under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
